text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is not a review article; it is an analysis harmonizing land-use CO2 flux estimates from global models and national greenhouse gas inventories. Instead, it deals with reconciling existing estimates of historical land-use CO2 fluxes from models and inventories, without LULC prediction or scenario simulation components. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction-focused research and does not meet the requirements for inclusion.)
